## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] All 3 impl-plan steps (2, 4, 6) have inline loop blocks with: cycle declaration, oscillation-check (cycle >= 2), HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity, REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream signal, mid-loop success exit, PROTOCOL_ERROR, See: pointer
- [ ] All 3 step loop blocks scoped correctly per awk extraction
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh → PASS
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS (non-regression)
